target: Spoiler-free completion of every documented original-cabinet reel system, bonus type, ART state, premium branch, setting, and Wesker Mode encounter presentation

areas.name: Original Yamasa Cabinet
areas.location_cue: The three-reel Japanese cabinet with its upper video display and BIOHAZARD branding.
areas.note: Physical cabinet and randomized amusement sequences only.

save_backup.title: Record the cabinet state now
save_backup.why: Randomized modes and configuration changes cannot be reconstructed from a normal save.

point_of_no_return.title: Power or setting change
point_of_no_return.warning: Photograph counters and finish the active mode before changing cabinet configuration.

levels.1: The machine hardware is the only verified playable release.
levels.2: Use an original 2008 Yamasa pachislot cabinet.
levels.3: Verify the cabinet, reels, stop buttons, lever, credit controls, hopper, and video display work before counting any sequence; no documented home port replaces this route.

levels.1: Internal configuration changes the probability table.
levels.2: With owner/service access, verify normal play under each numbered setting.
levels.3: Power down, use the cabinet setting key, select one setting, restart, and record the displayed configuration. Repeat for settings 1–6 without treating payout variance as missing content.

levels.1: Completion requires sequences, not gambling losses.
levels.2: Operate with owned test medals or cabinet credit mode only.
levels.3: Use a privately owned machine in legal non-cash mode, fill the hopper or enable credits according to its service manual, and never frame monetary return as a completion objective.

levels.1: The cabinet glass identifies its ordinary symbol results.
levels.2: Land each standard printed payout pattern at least once.
levels.3: Follow the cabinet paytable rather than guessing symbols, record each unique award when the credit meter changes, and retain a photo of the payline and meter for the completion log.

levels.1: One large bonus ends after a payout threshold.
levels.2: Enter BIG Bonus and play until its normal termination.
levels.3: During BIG, follow the reel guidance until total payout passes 408 medals; verify the mode closes normally and the net gain is approximately 342 rather than using that estimate as an exact target.

levels.1: The smaller bonus ends by games or winning results.
levels.2: Enter REG Bonus and reach its built-in endpoint.
levels.3: Play REG until either twelve bonus games have elapsed or six winning results register. Confirm the mode exits; roughly eighty net medals is descriptive, not a completion condition.

items.label: Convert a Single Bonus into ART

levels.1: A voice and button prompt precede the assisted sequence.
levels.2: When a Single Bonus occurs, follow its first-stop symbol and remaining stop-order guidance.
levels.3: On the spoken chance prompt, visually time the specified symbol on the first reel, then press the other reels in the displayed order. Aligning the required sevens moves the machine from assist state into ART.

levels.1: The standard assisted run is arranged in a fixed-size set.
levels.2: Enter Biohazard ART and finish one fifty-game set.
levels.3: Maintain the prompted reel order through all fifty games, avoid an incorrect first stop, and record the transition or continuation screen at the set boundary.

levels.1: A rare confrontation can upgrade the assisted run.
levels.2: Win the qualifying confrontation and enter Premium ART.

items.label: Carry Premium ART to BIG Bonus

levels.1: Premium status protects the route into the next major bonus.
levels.2: Remain in Premium ART until the guaranteed next BIG Bonus begins.
levels.3: Follow every navigation prompt, do not interrupt power, and continue through all ART sets until BIG starts; record whether the post-BIG continuation succeeds because its chance is fifty percent.

levels.1: One branch after the protected BIG can extend the mode.
levels.2: Obtain a successful Premium ART continuation after the next BIG.
levels.3: Because the continuation check is random, preserve the cabinet state and keep playing valid Premium cycles until the continuation presentation occurs; do not claim deterministic input control.

levels.1: The same random branch also has a closing presentation.
levels.2: Observe the non-continuing result after a Premium-linked BIG.
levels.3: Play a separate naturally reached Premium cycle until its fifty-percent continuation check fails, then record the distinct end-state presentation before returning to normal play.
